name: status-bar
description: Status line with git branch, diff size, PR state, CI checks and plan usage

showBranch.title: Show branch
showBranch.description: The current branch, or the short SHA on a detached HEAD.

showDiff.title: Show diff
showDiff.description: Lines added and removed against the merge base with the default branch, uncommitted work included.

showPullRequest.title: Show pull request
showPullRequest.description: The state of the branch's pull request: Merged, Closed, Draft or Open. Needs the GitHub CLI.

showChecks.title: Show CI checks
showChecks.description: Passed checks out of the total for the branch's pull request. Needs the GitHub CLI.

showUsage.title: Show plan usage
showUsage.description: The plan's 5-hour session usage and weekly usage.

iconBranch.title: Branch icon
iconBranch.description: Drawn before the branch name. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconDiff.title: Diff icon
iconDiff.description: Drawn before the added and removed lines. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconPullRequest.title: Pull request icon
iconPullRequest.description: Drawn before the pull request state. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconChecksPassed.title: CI passed icon
iconChecksPassed.description: Drawn before the checks when every one passed. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconChecksFailed.title: CI failed icon
iconChecksFailed.description: Drawn before the checks when any failed. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconChecksPending.title: CI running icon
iconChecksPending.description: Drawn before the checks while some are still running. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.

iconUsage.title: Usage icon
iconUsage.description: Drawn before the plan usage. Spaces count; leave it empty for no icon.
